checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals landing-page, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals landing-page.

checks.description: Every text region binds to a QA-passed copy-package variant id; no free copy is written on the page.
checks.rule: Output includes copy_refs binding each region to a variant id, and a hard rule that copy is never invented.

checks.description: The page has exactly one clear primary CTA.
checks.rule: Layout and hard rules state one clear CTA, not two competing primary actions.

checks.description: The page uses the exact brand visual constants.
checks.rule: Visual section names #141414 background, #1A1A1A surfaces, and #009975 accent.

checks.description: The page is RTL-correct: direction rtl, Arabic primary, mixed direction and numerals do not break.
checks.rule: Body specifies direction rtl, Arabic primary, Western numerals, and mixed-direction handling.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals.

checks.description: Never imply accreditation; never invent Skill Path titles, instructor names, offers, or prices.
checks.rule: Hard rules forbid accreditation implication and invented titles, names, offers, or prices.

checks.description: The output populates the page field of the conversion-package.
checks.rule: Output is described as the page field of the conversion-package.
